channel.title: Comic Relief's Hits and Hidden Gems at the BBC
channel.desc: Radio 2's Scott Mills takes a celebratory look back at the greatest musical moments from past Red Nose Days. It's a selection that doesn't just include chart-topping tracks like One Direction, the Spice Girls and Adele - there are also gems that won't be as familiar but still more than stand the test of time, including rarely seen performances from Sam Smith and John Legend, Justin Bieber, Marti Pellow, McFly, and Robbie Coltrane and Helen Mirren.
